summary: Fixed shadow classifier receiving cosine_sim=0 for all note cluster verdicts. Two changes: (1) lib/judge.js now exports `cosine` (re-exported from lib/embed.js) so routes/judge.js can call it. (2) routes/judge.js gains a `clusterMaxCosine(overlay, keys)` helper that computes max pairwise cosine from note vectors at verdict time. This helper is now used in all three cluster verdict appendVerdict calls: `consolidate` (uses [keepKey, ...supersededKeys]), `surface` (uses surfaceCluster.keys), and `distinct` (markDistinct path — which also had no appendVerdict at all; added one with verdict:'distinct'). The two remaining `cosine: null` calls are for single-note verdicts (retire, markJudged) where pairwise cosine is inapplicable.
